property_summary: After any sequence of calls ending with withdrawAll, the contract balance must be zero only if the caller is the owner.
Only the owner can successfully withdraw all balance; a non-owner caller leaves the balance unchanged.
Only the owner can withdraw all funds; after withdrawAll, address(this).balance is zero if and only if msg.sender was the owner.
After withdrawAll, the contract's ether balance is always zero, regardless of caller.
After withdrawAll, the contract ether balance is zero exactly when the caller is the owner.

After a fuzzed call to withdrawAll, the owner's balance equals the sum of the initial contract balance and the initial owner balance only if the call with all gas does not revert, otherwise no state changes.
After calling withdrawAll, the contract's balance is always zero if the call succeeds, otherwise remains unchanged.
After a successful withdrawAll call, the contract's ETH balance must be zero, regardless of how the call is executed.
After calling withdrawAll with the owner, the contract balance is always zero.
After calling withdrawAll with the owner, the contract balance must be zero.
